Collaborative Series

CRX-10iA/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics. This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing applications.

CRX-10iA/L Paint
Collaboration

FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.
